name: Shitao
contribution: A Chinese Buddhist monk, calligrapher, and landscape painter during the early Qing dynasty.

checks.lead: Shitao or Shi Tao (simplified Chinese: 石涛; traditional Chinese: 石濤; pinyin: Shí Tāo; Wade–Giles: Shih-t'ao), otherwise known as Yuan Ji (Chinese: 原濟; Chinese: 原济; pinyin: Yuán Jì) (1642 – 1707), born into the Ming dynasty imperial clan as Zhu Ruoji (朱若極), was a Chinese Buddhist monk, calligrapher, and landscape painter during the early Qing dynasty.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
